events.title: Wisconsin Badgers vs. Minnesota Golden Gophers
events.blurb: The Paul Bunyan’s Axe rivalry game under the lights on Black Friday, on NBC.
events.blurbEs: El clásico por el Hacha de Paul Bunyan bajo las luces el Black Friday, transmitido por NBC.

events.title: Maybe Happy Ending
events.blurb: The Tony-winning musical about two robots, in its Wisconsin premiere; six shows this weekend.
events.blurbEs: El musical ganador del Tony sobre dos robots, en su estreno en Wisconsin; seis funciones este fin de semana.

events.title: A Charlie Brown Christmas with Strings
events.blurb: The jazz trio Mr. Chair, the Wisconsin Chamber Orchestra and Madison Youth Choirs singers play the Peanuts holiday music. About 90 minutes.
events.blurbEs: El trío de jazz Mr. Chair, la Wisconsin Chamber Orchestra y cantantes de Madison Youth Choirs interpretan la música navideña de Peanuts. Unos 90 minutos.

events.title: Wisconsin Badgers hockey vs. Canisius
events.blurb: Men’s college hockey, a two-game weekend series.
events.blurbEs: Hockey universitario masculino, serie de dos partidos el fin de semana.

events.title: Chazen Museum of Art
events.blurb: UW–Madison’s art museum, free and open to the public; galleries open 11 a.m.–5 p.m. on weekends.
events.blurbEs: El museo de arte de UW–Madison, gratis y abierto al público; las galerías abren de 11 a. m. a 5 p. m. los fines de semana.
events.getThere: The State Street Campus Garage is the closest public parking; several Madison Metro routes stop nearby.
